title: Parse a bounded optional integer
prompt: Return an int for a complete decimal string in [0,1000]. Return std::nullopt for empty text, signs, trailing text, overflow, or out-of-range values. A string_view is length-bounded and is not assumed zero-terminated.

tests.label: Trailing characters
tests.hint: The whole view must be consumed.

tests.label: Empty and overflow
tests.hint: A failed conversion has no value.

hints: from_chars gives an end pointer and an error code.
Require end == text.data()+text.size() and validate the numeric domain.
explanation: optional<int> represents either an owned integer or no valid result. The parser uses the view’s explicit end address, so it never reads beyond a nonterminated slice.
